title: SM-WEB-001: isolate web query caches across account switches
authority: Owner accepted foundation/sprint-01 as the development base and the first bounded account-cache correction. Read, isolated branch edits, regression checks, commit, push and draft PR are authorized by the development request; merge and production actions are not.
scope: One client-side account/session cache isolation defect.
out_of_scope: Backend auth/token rotation, POS money/business logic, unrelated UI changes, merges, production and Telegram.
task: Remount and dispose the query provider across login/dashboard boundaries; verify two-account behavior and late old-account responses in a real browser with synthetic BFF.
validation: Inspect full diff; preserve existing web lint/type/unit/build/audit checks; execute browser regression and inspect source-attributable Foundation CI. Local shell/browser commands are unavailable and must be NOT RUN.
artifacts: Safe source-attributable report, task packet and CI/PR links.
stop_conditions: Stop on wrong main/development head, conflicting code PR, unclear authority, unsafe data/credentials, required evidence failure or unrelated scope expansion.
success_criteria: No old identity, organization selection or branch/user/device data appears during next-account loading, including an old in-flight response; ordinary dashboard caching preserved.
